input.name: image
input.preprocess: EXIF rotate upright, letterbox to square with fill_rgb, resize to 224x224 bilinear, divide by 255

outputs.energy: out-of-scope score, -T*logsumexp(logits/T); reject product ID if energy > guard.threshold
outputs.ood_z: Mahalanobis score (synthetic fit); not used by the app when ood_z_enabled is false

decision_order: barcode found in product table -> use it, skip photo
guard score > guard.threshold -> not recognized: product list + code check
confidence_rule: show the product list if max(softmax(logits / temperature)) < confidence_threshold

guard.rule: reject the product ID (show the product list / code check) when score > threshold
